# Eugene Brady

> Official website of Eugene Brady — Irish director and photographer. Feature films include The Nephew, Missing Brendan, and The Girl Who Stayed (in development).

This site is a portfolio for professional directing and photography enquiries.

## Pages

- [Home](https://eugenebrady.com/): Overview of Eugene Brady as director and photographer
- [Film](https://eugenebrady.com/film): Filmography — The Nephew, Missing Brendan, The Girl Who Stayed; posters, synopses, and stills
- [Photography](https://eugenebrady.com/photography): Portrait photography and cinematic portrait studies
- [About](https://eugenebrady.com/about): Biography, BAFTA membership, and creative focus
- [Contact](https://eugenebrady.com/contact): Directing, photography, and development enquiries — info@eugenebrady.com

## Films

- [The Nephew (1998)](https://eugenebrady.com/film): Feature film starring Pierce Brosnan — IMDb Pro https://pro.imdb.com/title/tt0119772/
- [Missing Brendan (2003)](https://eugenebrady.com/film): Feature film starring Adam Brody — IMDb Pro https://pro.imdb.com/title/tt0311530/
- [The Girl Who Stayed](https://eugenebrady.com/film): Feature currently in development
